notes: Residual decisions for the armor-set derivation (pipeline/merge/armor.ts, P2-S8). Everything else — set membership (the pieces a set article hosts), per-helmet set bonus game text, set-bonus effects, defense totals, stage and every single-class variant — is derived from Cargo Items, Module:Iteminfo/data, Cargo Equipinfo and the set article's infobox. Every quote is checked verbatim against the cached article revision.

withhold: the ArmorSet schema needs ≥1 helmet, exactly one chest and one legs piece hosted by the set article, and a set bonus per helmet. Sets that cannot be expressed are not emitted; their pieces carry no setId and a gap entry records why (amendment candidates in the P2-S8 report).

classes: ArmorSet.variants[].class is a single DamageClass. Where the variant's stats name several classes, the set article's own description decides: the wiki calls these sets hybrids ('melee/ranged', 'mage/summoner', …) or describes no class at all, so the ruling is 'other' = no single class — the safe direction for class-filtered recommendations (they are under-, never wrongly recommended). The schema cannot express a hybrid class (amendment candidate: a class list per variant).
